observations.action: Navigate to product URL fresh (no prior session), pass Shopify password gate using TIB_STORE_PASSWORD (value never printed/logged), read Object.keys(localStorage) and localStorage.getItem('teeinblue-customizations') BEFORE any personalization interaction.
observations.observed_result: localStorage contains only 2 keys, both Shopify-native: 'signInWithShop:cartSyncTransferAttemptedAt' and 'shopify:webmcp_adapter_loaded'. localStorage.getItem('teeinblue-customizations') returns null (key does not exist). sessionStorage contains only Shopify instrumentation keys (consentHeader, __shopify_agent_context_events, _shs_state, rotating ri-*/wpm-ri-* session ids) — no teeinblue key.

observations.action: Inspect the PERSONALIZE panel DOM structure and window globals to identify the personalization mechanism before interacting.
observations.observed_result: Personalization UI is rendered directly in the main document (inside <product-form> > #tee-artwork-form, class 'tee-campaign tee-campaign-v1 tee-customization-wrapper'), NOT inside the page's only iframe (that iframe is a Shopify web-pixel sandbox, unrelated). window exposes teeinblue-prefixed globals: teeinblueShop, teeinblueCampaign, teeinblueDocumentReady, teeinblueAddLoader, teeinblueHideLoader, TeeinblueEventBus, teeinblue, TEEINBLUE_LOADED, TEEINBLUE_APP, TEEINBLUE_VUE — confirming a same-origin, non-iframed Vue-based app embed for SDK v1 on this theme.
observations.state_before: PERSONALIZE panel showing only the top-level 'Poster - Woman and dog clipart template' field (3 thumbnails, none selected)

evidence_refs.note: supporting DOM/globals inspection, not a numbered LS-SNAP

observations.action: Click the first template thumbnail (radio input, field id 4081, value 'template-277843'). Read localStorage immediately after the click (no wait) and again after an additional 1.5s settle.
observations.observed_result: Two new localStorage keys appear SYNCHRONOUSLY with the click (present in the 'immediate' read, identical after settle — no further async change): 'teeinblue-global-options' and 'teeinblue-customizations'. teeinblue-customizations is a JSON string encoding an ARRAY of one object: { productId, customization: { "4081": "template-277843", "global-option-847": <asset path>, "platform_linked_id": <shopify variant id> }, timestamp: <epoch ms> }. teeinblue-global-options is a JSON string encoding an OBJECT keyed by global-option numeric id, each value shaped { value: <asset path>, extra: {}, timestamp: <epoch ms> }. Selecting the template also auto-selected a default value for a dependent field ('global-option-847', the 'Choose Woman's Skin Tone' field) as a side effect — this default selection was written to localStorage too, even though the tester never clicked that field directly.
observations.state_after: teeinblue-customizations and teeinblue-global-options present, as described

observations.action: Type a synthetic (non-real-customer) value into the 'Woman Name' text field (name=global-option-849, maxlength=10). Read localStorage mid-typing (3 of 8 chars), immediately after finishing typing (still focused), and after blurring the field (clicking elsewhere).
observations.observed_result: The typed text is NOT written to teeinblue-customizations mid-typing, and NOT written immediately after typing completes while the field is still focused. It only appears in teeinblue-customizations after the field loses focus (blur). This is a different persistence trigger than the template/clipart radio fields in SF-OBS-003, which wrote to localStorage synchronously on click/change. The top-level 'timestamp' field in the teeinblue-customizations entry is updated (a newer epoch-ms value) at the moment of the blur-triggered write.
observations.state_before: teeinblue-customizations.customization has keys {4081, global-option-847, platform_linked_id} only
observations.state_after: teeinblue-customizations.customization additionally has key global-option-849 (redacted free-text value)

observations.action: With template selected and Woman Name field filled+blurred (teeinblue-customizations populated), reload the page (page.reload()). Compare localStorage content and DOM form state before vs. after reload.
observations.observed_result: localStorage keys teeinblue-customizations and teeinblue-global-options SURVIVE the reload with byte-identical values (persisted, not cleared). However, the DOM form does NOT restore from this stored state: after reload, the PERSONALIZE panel resets to its default collapsed view — none of the 3 template thumbnails is marked selected, and the dependent fields (skin tone, hairstyle, Woman Name, cat breed, cat name) are not rendered at all, exactly as on a completely fresh visit. This is a save-without-restore behavior: the draft is retained in the browser but the storefront app does not read it back into the form on load.
observations.state_before: Form showing template #1 selected, dependent fields visible, Woman Name field populated with synthetic text
observations.state_after: Form reset to only the top-level 3-thumbnail template selector, nothing selected, dependent fields absent from DOM

observations.action: During the template-selection click that first produced the teeinblue-customizations key (SF-OBS-003), capture all non-static (non-image/font/stylesheet) network requests in a ~1.2s window around the click and check for any XHR/fetch.
observations.observed_result: Zero XHR/fetch requests were captured in that window. This is a single-sample observation supporting (not proving) that the initial write is purely client-side/local, with no synchronous backend call at that moment.

feature_candidates.candidate: Client-side personalization draft persistence via localStorage (key 'teeinblue-customizations', plus companion key 'teeinblue-global-options')
feature_candidates.note: User's hypothesis (key name 'teeinblue-customizations') CONFIRMED to exist and match exactly. Mechanism details (shape, write timing, no-restore-on-reload) go beyond what was hypothesized and are reported as newly observed, not assumed.
